Subject: Re: Freelance Project Contract

Hi Eliana,

Thank you for reviewing the contract and for your feedback. I appreciate you bringing these points to my attention.

Regarding the payment terms, I understand your preference for a net-30 structure. I will discuss this with our finance team to see if we can accommodate a net-30 timeline or perhaps a hybrid approach. I will get back to you shortly with an update on this.

As for the non-compete clause, I agree that it is important for the terms to be equitable. Let’s schedule a brief call later this week to discuss potential adjustments that would work for both parties. Please let me know what days and times work best for you.

Best regards,

Ms. Adams
